description: Declare or clear branch and release governance so PR, merge, release, and publish actions can be evaluated against explicit workflow state.

baseBranch.description: Protected base branch for merge and release operations (defaults to main)

branchName.description: Optional branch name the governance applies to

clear.description: Clear the current branch governance state instead of setting it

localOnly.description: When true, PR, merge, release, and publish actions are blocked for this lane

prNumber.description: Optional pull request number once a PR exists

prRequired.description: Whether this lane must go through a pull request (defaults to true)

prUrl.description: Optional pull request URL once a PR exists

queueRequired.description: Whether the target branch requires a merge queue

releaseEvidence.description: Optional evidence or release plan note for the governed version

releaseSensitiveGlobs.description: Optional custom globs that define release-sensitive files for this branch lane

releaseVersion.description: Expected package version for release or publish actions

name: set_branch_governance
title: Set Branch Governance
